evidence.quote: Current and conditional candidate peaks follow.

CA.rationale: No explicit attention/processing condition linked to content organization was found.

COD.rationale: Content (p0/current/n1/red), an organization-like presentation (coordinate set), and an explicit origin/status entry are all present for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing condition is linked to the identified content's organization or access.

C.rationale: Report explicitly lists identified content items (color-labeled coordinate sets) for current referents.

D.rationale: Origin/status metadata is provided separately from the coordinate content, distinguishing identification from source/status.

O.rationale: The report states how content is presented (grid orientation) and gives organized coordinate listings for specific referents.
